NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a Special Meeting of the City Council will be held on
Thursday, October 22, 2020, at 4:00 P.M., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood,
California (Government Code Section 54956)

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the
social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp -content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20 -N-29-20-EO.pdf), please note that members of the
public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council Meeting of October 22, 2020, at 4:00 P.M. as
follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance
  Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  C l e r k / S e c r e t a r y a t yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, a n d D e p u t y C i t y C l e r k
  aphillips@cityofinglewood.org . To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 12:00 P.M. the day of the meeting, and
  in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence
  should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. and prior to
  the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public record of the meeting.
  Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310 -412-5280 with any questions.

  2.  By Telephone -Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of the public
  can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make comments by using the following:

  l Dial -In: 1-669-900-6833 (Meeting ID: 947 1802 1672; Passcode: 637387).
  l  All interested parties who wished to provide public comments telephonically may join the conference
  at 3:50 p.m.
  l If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception. Calls from
  landline phones are highly recommended.
  l If you are watching the meeting via Facebook Live or Channel 35 while also accessing the phone line,
  it is requested that you mute the sound of your video feed as it is delayed from the phone
  transmission. Additionally, when you are making public comments on the phone line, you will be
  inaudible due to feedback.

** The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to address the Legislative Body on
Special Meeting Agenda Items

  3.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  Ø On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable
  provider for details.
  l Ø Live on-line through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video, at
  https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/ .

however, members of the public who wish to orally address the Legislative Body must use the public access
options 2 and 3 noted above.

Inglewood, California
  October 22, 2020

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Thursday, October 22, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council to order at the hour of 4:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales,
  and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Jeffrey Lewis  Acting City Attorney

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any
  persons present who wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

131.8  AMENDMENT TWO TO AGREEMENT 19-302 APPROVED - MEYERS NAVE
  RIBACK  SILVER  &  WILSON,  PC; SPECIAL COUNSEL  TO
  CONTRACTUALLY ENGAGE INTERWEST CONSULTING GROUP INC., AND
  DEL RICHARDSON & ASSOCIATES, INC. AUTHORIZED. Staff report dated
  October 22, 2020, was presented recommending approval of Amendment Two to
  Agreement No. 19-302 with Meyers Nave Riback Silver & Wilson, PC to expand the
  scope of the legal services provided to the City.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Amendment Two in the amount of
  $650,900; and 2) Provide authorization for Special Counsel to contractually engage
  Interwest Consulting Group Inc., and Del Richardson & Associates, Inc., for certain right
  of way and relocation services, respectively. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes:  None.

131.8  AGREEMENT NO. 21-033 APPROVED - ECO & ASSOCIATES, INC. Staff report
  dated October 22, 2020, was presented recommending approval of a one-year Agreement
  with Eco & Associates, Inc., to conduct Limited Soil and Soil Gas Environmental Site
  Investigation on certain parcels comprising the Inglewood Basketball and Entertainment
  Center Project (IBEC Project).

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 21-033 in an amount not to
  exceed $70,328. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes:  None.

  1
 October 22, 2020

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 4:03 p.m.

  Approved this 18th day of May, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
